name: the store dies after 40 requests in the middle of 100 uploads: the index never names a missing blob, the rest is retried
description: INFOMANIAK-003 (Infomaniak): a power module cut the data centre's power briefly and servers restarted. Rules V1, A7 and E5: blobs first, then the index by compare-and-swap, so a store that dies mid-upload leaves an index whose every entry is stored; the client retries the rest; every file reads back identical. sync-chaos srv-node-lost-during-upload (its real node kill is a dc scenario).

name: the connection drops after the blobs are stored and before the commit: nothing half committed, the next pass commits once
description: INFOMANIAK-003 (Infomaniak): an outage between upload and commit. Rules A7 and E5: the index is written only after its blobs; a lost commit is retried; blobs already up are not sent again.

name: a storage node hard-killed mid-upload and restarted
description: INFOMANIAK-003 (Infomaniak): the server's own durability across a power cut (rule V1) is iso's; sync-chaos srv-node-lost-during-upload runs it against the stack.
not_applicable: killing a storage node is the server stack's (iso, rule V1, dc scenario srv-node-lost-during-upload); AzDrive's stand-in remote is a folder, the client half is the two tests above
